resources.string: Your move in a small square determines where the opponent must play on the large board.
If you are sent to a block that is already finished, you can play anywhere on the board.
Win small blocks to claim them on the large board. Get three in a row on the large board to win!
To win a small block, get three symbols in a row within it. The entire block will then be marked with your symbol.
If a small block ends in a draw, it becomes blocked for everyone, and no one gets the point for it on the large board.
